evals.prompt: Define a read-only Linear issue tool and a write action that creates an issue, then explain how each maps to governed connector capabilities and policy checks.
evals.expected_output: Creates or describes tool definitions and semantic bindings using the kei-agents package, distinguishing connector reads from agent actions.
expectations: The response keeps provider execution and credentials out of kei-agents definitions.
The response distinguishes a connector read from a write action with a policy boundary.

evals.prompt: Render the same tool definitions for OpenAI and Anthropic and validate them before exposing them to an agent. Which package APIs and source files should I inspect?
evals.expected_output: Points to render_tools, ModelFormat, validation, and the package source/docs without guessing unsupported model formats or fields.
expectations: The response recommends validation before publication or execution.
The response directs the user to the package source and docs as the authority for exact API names.
